address: 28 Lincoln St, Essex Junction, VT 05452, USA
notes:
11th step music and art based meditation meeting with open discussion.

Higher power,

Let this art be a witness to your majesty and love, and remind us that you are always watching, and listening.

May your presence and beauty be found in every note, and may the words that are sung reach the hearts of others so they will draw closer to you.

May your Spirit guide us through every measure so that we might be the instruments of your peace, and proclaim your glory with glad voices.

May our art be a channel through which your light flows freely, passing through our hearts and souls and onto paper, so that we may share your infinite love with those around us.
